description: This file contains functions related to MAC address retrieval, manipulation, and system information, specifically tailored for OpenWrt devices. It includes methods for reading MAC addresses from various sources such as device tree, JSON configuration, MTD partitions, and MMC devices, as well as functions for MAC address manipulation and system version detection.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a specified file at a given offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from device tree.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from /etc/board.json configuration.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Attempts to get MAC address label from device tree, falls back to JSON.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device path for a given MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII form from a partition or file.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII from a specified MTD partition and key.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves encrypted MAC address from a partition, decrypts using uencrypt or openssl.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address from a partition using a specific key.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from UCI config stored in UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address as text from a partition at a specific offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_part_size
methods.description: Returns size of a specified MTD partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Gets binary MAC address from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on MMC device CID hash.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string with separator.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'local administration' bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the multicast bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Converts a MAC address to canonical form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled.

methods.name: get_linux_version
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the Linux kernel version.
